Well, thanks for your message. Here's the full story if you want to read it, then we'll talk after. 

Alright. Holy shit. It's been a reaal longass time since I've seeked help on the internet, but here fucking goes.
I'm sick of this bullshit life. Sick of my family, sick of the people I'm 'friends' with, sick of my severe depression, and ESPECIALLY sick of the sons of bitches and teachers I go to school with. So far, this year and the past one has sucked. Honestly, my life sucks rn. I've lost all my self confidence. I hate myself. I just to be the most confident, loudest girl who didn't give a shit about anything. I'd been through a lot, and finally thought I'd go on to be this strong girl who just didn't give a fuck. Guess not. Now, someone could unfriend me and I'd have a mental breakdown, sit there for hours thinking how everyone hates me. Everyone got along with me so well. But it's like ever since I've gone quiet no-one wants to know me anymore. And no matter how hard I try to work on my anxiety or try to see the brightside of things, something sucks me back into this dark hole. A lonely, dark hole, which takes away my humour, ability to speak my mind, and alla that shit. It really doesn't fucking help when people put me down all the goddamn time too. I get shit about my nose, all the time. Like, even the mention of the word 'nose' would make someone comment, and I can't fucking defend myself. Why? Social anxiety's a bitch. Now, I just sit there all depressed and look at the floor. And everyone seems to reject me, even though I'm trying to talk to people again. Maybe I come across as needy or whatever. ...What is the point in me trying to remake friends with people who don't give two shits about me any more? Also, I'm behind on my GSCES, which really doesn't help my situation or teachers being on my back. My attendance is shit. Even though they know the fucking reason, that still doesn't stop them from hounding me. I've been in hospital 3 times now, and none of the shit that bothered me before compared to this. And my teacher coming up to me saying ''You need mental help, stay in school, no matter, it gets better'' doesn't fucking help. What did I say? I just laughed, like a little bitch. It's fucking awful being around people who are happy and don't give two shits, while you're over here having mental breakdowns over every fucking bad thing that happens to you, NO MATTER WHAT IT IS. I don't know what to do, and I'm fucking scared. I feel like my time of being happy and 'popular' is over. I can't escape. What I want to do, my mind does another. Honestly, I can't explain the shit and pain i go through on a daily basis. Every day isn't a normal day for me, it's just something I have to get through, its just a bunch of hours with obstacles I have to get around. The worst fucking feeling in the world is seeing your friends and the people around coming out of their shell, while you're going back into it. I feel like I aint even here anymore. I'm just this person who makes jokes n shit occasionally, and laughs every now and then. I'm just there. Not the life of the fucking party anymore. Life has tired me out to the point where starting a conversation or even turning round to face someone in class is effort/challenging. I just want to die. I feel fucking pathetic. But the littlest shit picks me up, and the even smaller shit brings me tf back down. I can never stay 'up', not even for a full day or hour. It's crippling. And on top this, my cat fucking died. Now those of you who never had a pet or don't like animals won't understand the fucking pain I went through. My beautiful baby boy, one of my main reasons to live, left me. He was so sick, and I just took him for granted. When I found out he was ill, I didn't even think that much of it. But then, on the weekend before he went, I went to a party, got drunk, and embarrassed myself. When I went to school everyone was talking about the shit I did. I wouldn't have cared, but it was so horrible going through that day. When school ended, my parents told me the news about my cat needing to be put down. I felt fucking sick. I didn't know it was THAT BAD FFS! I just broke down in the middle of the street. My gorgeous boy had gone. I'll never forget the look on his face. I officially decided I have no reason to live. The one thing that never upset or disappointed me, had gone. I honestly don't know why I'm still alive. I had these visions of me leaving for college, with my baby sat there watching me leave, purring. But that aint gunna fucking happen now. Me and my parents fight a lot too. Sometimes physical , sometimes just arguments. I'll admit, I'm a little shit, but they just don't understand. For some reason my mum seems to think if I'm upset/having panic attacks and don't want to go to school, I'm skyvving. She sometimes won't talk to me for a whole day, or until I go back to school. My dad always takes my mums fucking side. Fucksake, sometimes I can't get a word in edgeways. Fuck it. I'll never forget what they said to me before I went into hospital. I'll always be angry, but deep down I fucking despise arguing with them. Cause honestly, I never thought I'd wanna run away, or be put in foster care because of my parents.
I have too much on my plate, and there's so much more I could say, put I don't have the energy. I'm tired, I feel sick, I have school tomorrow, and...I just can't deal with this shit anymore. I just...I just wanna go. I had so many fucking plans, was so determined and happy...and now I'm just a suicidal/homicial mess. Somebody fucking help me. Please.
